# dsh-skill-map
English | 中文
**It sorts all your skills, so you can find the right one fast.**
Once you have installed a lot of skills in DSH, the names stop telling you which one does what. This
plugin (a small add-on for DSH) puts them on one page in the right sidebar, and you group them your
own way. Code in one pile, docs in another, spreadsheets in a third — or often used and rarely used
own way. Code in one pile, docs in another, spreadsheets in a third — or often used and rarely used.
What you sort is saved on your own computer, so a new version of the plugin will not wipe it.
## What it looks like
## What it does

- One more page in the right sidebar, just for skills.
- One workspace is one way of sorting. Click

the little tab on top to switch to another way.
- Want to keep another way of sorting? Click "+" to

make one; double-click a tab to rename it, click "×" to delete it (it asks first).
- On first open,

you can let AI sort everything for you once.
- Or make your own categories first, then let AI put th

e skills that are still loose into them. Anything you placed stays where you put it.
- Categories ca

n be renamed, dragged into a new order, or deleted. Drag a skill and it moves to another category.
-
Each skill is one line: the name, then one sentence about what it does. Hover over the line to see

which GitHub project it came from and a longer description.
- The search box finds skills by name an

d by those descriptions.
- Click a line and `/skill-name` is copied, ready to paste into the compose

r.
- Not sure where a skill goes yet? Drop it in "Unassigned" at the bottom of the list.
- If a desc
ription looks thin, press Update and let AI write more. AI never overwrites a line you wrote yoursel
ption looks thin, press Update and let AI write more. AI never overwrites a line you wrote yourself.

## For more detail
The fine print, for people who want it. Click to open.
Where it shows up, where the file lives, changing the language
- With `dsh-better-sidebar` installed it is a tab in that sidebar; without it, a tab in the official

right Sidebar (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right`), opened once on first load.
- When neith
er right sidebar is running it falls back to a central panel and adds an icon in the sidebar's panel

list, so there is always a way in.
- Everything you sort lives in `$DSH_HOME/skill-map/map.json`. I
f the file is missing or broken it goes back to "no workspace yet" instead of planting a classificat

ion you never confirmed.
- The gear in the header switches the description language: the skill's own
text, or a translation cache in `$DSH_HOME/skill-map/descriptions.<lang>.json`. A skill with no row
in the cache keeps its own text.
Config
| Key | Type | Meaning |

| `enabled` | boolean | Master switch for the host routes. |
| `customSkillDirs` | string[] | Extra

skill roots to scan besides the official ones. |
| `dshHome` | string | DSH home override; the works

pace document lives under it. |
| `agentsHome` | string | Agents home override (`~/.agents`). |
| `s
yncModel` | string | Model route (`provider/model`) used by Update and auto classify. Defaults to th
e model this profile's agent runs. |
Routes
| Route | Method | Meaning |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/list` | GET | Every skill, plus each workspace with its placements resolved. |

| `/api/dsh-skill-map/save` | POST | Writes the whole workspace document. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/w
orkspaces/auto` | POST | Classify with the model: propose a scheme for an empty workspace, place onl

y the unassigned skills in one that already has categories. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/health` | GET |

Health check carrying the skill and workspace counts. |
| `/api/dsh-skill-map/sync` | POST | Asks th
e model for the missing and changed copy. |
Security and limits
- At most 20 workspaces, and at most 200 categories per workspace; categories are flat, with no nest

ing.
- Every route is loopback-only (or a paired device), and skill roots are read-only; the plugin

writes only its own files under the DSH home directory.
- The workspace document is written atomical

ly and parsed defensively; a broken file degrades to the blank state.
- Update and auto classify nee
d an `llm` service in the profile; without one they report it as unavailable, and a scheme proposal

falls back to the built-in table.
- The browser half sends one anonymous install heartbeat per UTC d
ay (random id plus package name): src/client/telemetry.ts.
